name: HOZO private LINE claims entry
requiresDatabases: HOZO AM 2.0 group bindings with claim governance fields and exact member user IDs

dataIsolation.guard: A direct claim command may create a signed LIFF session only when the exact LINE user ID resolves to one tenant and exactly one active, claim-enabled, allowlisted source binding.

definitionOfDone: The personal-assistant fallback delegates claim commands to later direct-message modules
The claims module handles direct claim commands without sending them through group collection
Exactly one active claim-enabled allowlisted source creates a signed 15-minute LIFF card
No eligible source, multiple eligible sources, and lookup failure all fail closed
Existing group claims behavior remains unchanged
The production Rich Menu action `我要請款` returns a claim card for an authorized known partner
Opening the card verifies LINE identity and renders the correct source form without submitting a financial transaction
